quirks.leakageNote:
LM Studio's gemma4 chat template emits chain-of-thought as plain text
bracketed by literal '<|channel>thought\n' and '<channel|>' markers
rather than reasoningType=reasoning fragments. Clio's lmstudio-native
adapter buffers and re-classifies these regions into ThinkingContent
so the markers do not leak into the visible TUI text and reasoning
tokens are accounted via the chars/4 estimator.

runtimePreference.lmstudioNative: Verified path. Pin parallel=1 in the LM Studio per-model preset to give a single agent the full 122880 context.
runtimePreference.openaiCompat: Fallback path; the openai-compat surface does not expose the channel-marker classifier so visible text shows the raw markers.

quirks.serving: LilaRest publishes no per-model sampler; values inherit the gemma family default per the official Google Gemma 4 31B card. KV cache budget at f16, ctx=122880 is roughly 57 GB on top of ~21 GB of NVFP4 weights.

thinking.guidance:
Gemma 4 chat template exposes thinking only as on or off; intermediate
levels coerce to on. NVFP4 quantization can corrupt JSON tool-call
output under aggressive sampling, so the instruct profile pins
temperature at 0.7. The lmstudio-native adapter re-classifies the
channel-marker thought region into ThinkingContent so markers do not
leak into visible text.

Gemma 4 chat templates expose thinking only as on or off via
enable_thinking, the same as the rest of the Gemma 4 family.

thinking.guidance:
Distilled traces emit unconditionally. The thinking level setting is
ignored at the API surface; chain-of-thought arrives whether or not

quirks.thinkingControl:
Jackrong's distilled gemma-4 31B uses the same channel-marker template.
Thinking mode is gated by the literal '<|think|>' token in the system
prompt; Clio does not currently inject it, so the model emits an empty
thought region followed by the answer.
